subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: After the sandbox and fail-closed blockers are fixed, should OpenClaw accept this new plugin-owned Control UI app-nav entry-point API now, or keep it behind the broader Control UI contribution-slot RFC?
rationale: The patch creates a new public plugin SDK and gateway protocol contract with security implications, so implementation correctness alone does not settle whether this is the permanent API shape maintainers want.

options.title: Repair then review API shape
options.body: Fix the security blockers, refresh current-head proof, then have maintainers review the app-nav entry-point API against the broader plugin contribution-slot direction.

options.title: Narrow to RFC work
options.body: Pause this PR and fold the app-nav use case into the existing Control UI contribution-slot RFC before adding public SDK surface.

options.title: Decline this core seam
options.body: Close the PR if maintainers decide plugin app navigation should not become a core SDK/gateway contract at this time.

recommendation.title: Repair then review API shape
recommendation.body: Fix the security blockers, refresh current-head proof, then have maintainers review the app-nav entry-point API against the broader plugin contribution-slot direction.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest recent history across the plugin SDK, gateway, UI, and public contract surfaces touched by this PR.
